meta.name: writing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一份需求或规格说明拆成一步步可执行的实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有了需求和规格,却不知道从哪一步开始动手
copy.tagline_en: Turn a spec or set of requirements into a step-by-step implementation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have requirements but no clear order of steps to build them

howto.what: 你给出规格说明后,它会把实现计划写成文档:每个任务列出要改的文件、接口,以及逐步的 TDD 动作(写失败测试→验证失败→最小实现→验证通过→提交),存到 docs/superpowers/plans/ 下。写完后它自查,并请你选执行方式。
howto.when: 当你有某个多步任务的规格或需求、且还没开始动代码时使用;它会在开始时报出「I'm using the writing-plans skill」。若规格涉及多个独立子系统,它会建议拆成多份计划。

say.text: 这是我的需求文档,帮我写成实现计划并保存。
say.note: 它会生成计划文件,再请你选执行方式。

say.text: 把这个规格按子系统拆成多份实现计划。
say.note: 适用于规格涵盖多个独立子系统时。

say.text: 每个任务按 TDD 写步骤,从失败测试到提交。
say.note: 会补上测试与提交的具体命令。

howto.what_en: From a spec, it writes a plan: each task names files, interfaces, and step-by-step TDD actions (failing test, minimal code, verify pass, commit), saved to docs/superpowers/plans/. It then asks you to pick an execution method.
howto.when_en: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task and haven't touched code yet. If the spec spans independent subsystems, it suggests splitting into one plan per subsystem.

say_en.text: Here's my spec—turn it into an implementation plan and save it.
say_en.note: It writes the plan file and asks you to choose an executor.

say_en.text: Split this spec into separate plans, one per subsystem.
say_en.note: Use when the spec covers independent subsystems.

say_en.text: Write TDD steps for each task, from failing test to commit.
say_en.note: Each step gets the test and commit commands.
